CFML Language Reference: Functions

GetDirectoryFromPath

Returns everything up to and including the last directory separator of a path, which is the directory in which the file lives.

Category

System functions

Syntax

GetDirectoryFromPath(path)

Parameters

path
An absolute path, usually from GetCurrentTemplatePath or ExpandPath.

Returns

The directory, ending with a separator.

Usage

The file name part is returned by GetFileFromPath. Both "/" and Windows-style "\\" separators are recognized, so paths written for a Windows server (C:\\CFUSION\\...) work too.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Path = GetCurrentTemplatePath()>
<CFSET Spool = GetDirectoryFromPath(Path) & "mail/spool/Mail1.cfmail">
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Path</TH><TH>GetDirectoryFromPath</TH><TH>GetFileFromPath</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>#Path#</TD><TD>#GetDirectoryFromPath(Path)#</TD><TD>#GetFileFromPath(Path)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>#Spool#</TD><TD>#GetDirectoryFromPath(Spool)#</TD><TD>#GetFileFromPath(Spool)#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

GetFileFromPath, GetCurrentTemplatePath, ExpandPath
